attributes.description: This dashboard provides an overview of Vulnerability collected via Google Threat Intelligence.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides an overview of vulnerabilities collected via Google Threat Intelligence, focusing on vulnerability distribution and risk analysis.

It tracks the total number of vulnerabilities, along with trends over time and breakdowns by exploitation state, priority, risk rating, and status, helping analysts prioritize remediation efforts.

Saved searches streamline investigations by summarizing vulnerabilities along with their CVSS v2, CVSS v3, CVSS v3 (translated), and CVSS v4 scoring details.

[**Integrations Page**](/app/integrations/detail/ti_google_threat_intelligence/overview)
